definitions.definition: w_eff = -1 - (1/3) d ln rho_4/d ln a

rho4.A_compact_coordinate_period: ASSUMPTION: the extra times and the hidden direction are compact with a fixed coordinate period; rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.B_per_unit_coordinate_volume: per unit coordinate volume of the extra times and the hidden direction; rho_4 ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.C_per_unit_proper_7_volume: rho_4 = E/Vol_7 x (constant) ~ E e^{a4} b4^{-2}

history: a4 = H x4 and b4 = e^((4/3) H x4) PRESCRIBED (test field, no back-reaction); beta = 4/3; slices a4 in [0, 2]; a = e^(a4 - a4_today)

series.status: E = P3 = Pt = P0 = 0 at every slice (the k = 0 fold zero modes have eps = 0 and no interaction): no energy, w undefined

condensate.ratio_w: w_c = u/(2 + u), u = lambda S/m = u_today e^(-(5/3)(a4 - a4_today))
condensate.history: exact homogeneous solution for every a4(x4), b4(x4) (Revision/field_equations_a4/a4-equations.json fields.dirac16complex00.homogeneousCondensate); the 3-space observer's expansion-inferred w_exp = -1 exactly on a4 = H x4

expansion_inferred.statement: on the history a4 = H x4 (with b4 = e^((4/3) H x4)) the 3-space observer's Hubble rate a4' = H is constant (b4 does not enter a = e^{a4}): the expansion itself reads as w_exp = -1 exactly; the Kohn-Sham states are not admissible sources of the a4 equations (Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json), so no self-consistent history is available (OPEN)

kohn_sham_gas.A_B: w_eff(A) = 1/3 exactly for the free gas (fold band); interacting gas in the range of check interacting_gas_ranges; no dark-energy value
kohn_sham_gas.C: w_eff(C) = w_eff(A) - 4/9 in [-0.1139, -0.1083] (all gas series); tangent wa in [-0.0039, 0.0039], fitted wa in [-0.0024, 0.0023]; not the Unite values

unite_comparison.condensate: the condensate drifts: u = lambda S/m ~ e^(-(5/3) a4); at the u that gives the ratio -0.764 today its wa is -2.2462 (thawing sign), w_eff(A) = (5/9) w_c = -0.4244, w_eff(C) = (5/9) w_c - 4/9 = -0.8689, both with wa = -1.2479
unite_comparison.mixtures: free gas + lambda = 0 condensate: w_eff(C) >= -4/9, the Unite values are not reached; free gas + a drifting condensate: closest points to (-0.861, -0.60) in the three definitions in mixture_scan
unite_comparison.label: INTERPRETATION (labelled): the comparison treats the Unite numbers as constraints on the dilution of a 4-dimensional effective density; the Kohn-Sham history is a prescribed background without back-reaction
